name: delivery-survives-interruption
purpose: An event whose delivery is interrupted is delivered after restart, applied once per consumer; the projection replays identically (NFR-5).

given.text: Quorum is running with a published call, an officer, a chair, applicants and verified reviewers

when.text: p1 is submitted and the notification delivery fails before it is marked, then Quorum restarts

then.text: each consumer applied ProposalSubmitted exactly once
replaying the portfolio projection from the event log reproduces it exactly
